knowledge:
- key_parameters: reference=The reference signature matrix (e.g., HumanCellTypeMethAtlas) used to predict cell-type proportions ;; bulk=The bulk sample data frame to be deconvoluted ;; samples=The data frame of new samples to be added to the signature matrix in findSignatures ;; sampleMeta=A data table mapping sample names to their cell-type origins in findSignatures ;; IDs=The column name containing feature IDs (e.g., CpG probe IDs or Gene names) ;; probe_id_locations=A GRanges object containing genomic locations of probe IDs used in BSmeth2Probe ;; WGBS_data=WGBS methylation data in GRanges or methylKit format to be mapped in BSmeth2Probe ;; multipleMapping=Logical indicating whether to allow multiple mapping of WGBS loci to probes ;; cutoff=Maximum distance in base pairs allowed for mapping WGBS loci to probe locations ;; tissueSpecCpGs=Logical; if TRUE, findSignatures constructs a tissue-based methylation signature matrix ;; tissueSpecDMPs=Logical; if TRUE, findSignatures obtains tissue-based DMPs ;; K=Number of top signatures to select when tissueSpecCpGs is TRUE
- alternatives: None mentioned, but the package supports multiple internal deconvolution models including non-negative least squares regression, support vector regression, quadratic programming, and robust linear regression.
- when_to_use: Use when you need to estimate cell-type proportions from bulk methylation (WGBS/EPIC) or RNA-seq data, map WGBS genomic coordinates to Illumina probe IDs, or expand/customize a reference signature atlas.
- pitfalls: tissueSpecCpGs and tissueSpecDMPs cannot both be set to TRUE at the same time in findSignatures ;; For RNA-seq data, the IDs column must contain Gene names instead of probe IDs ;; Always check the partial R-squared values returned by deconvolute to ensure the deconvolution model provides an advantage over basic bimodal profiles.

workflows.name: wgbs_deconvolution
workflows.intent: Map WGBS methylation data to Illumina probe IDs and predict cell-type proportions using a reference atlas.
input: WGBS_GRanges.rda (WGBS methylation data as a GRanges object)
IlluminaMethEpicB5ProbeIDs (GRanges object containing probe ID locations)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the WGBS data and probe ID locations ;; 2. Map WGBS genomic coordinates to probe IDs using BSmeth2Probe ;; 3. Perform deconvolution on the mapped bulk data using deconvolute.
workflows.code:
load(system.file("extdata", "WGBS_GRanges.rda",
                                     package = "deconvR"))
data("IlluminaMethEpicB5ProbeIDs")
mapped_WGBS_data <- BSmeth2Probe(probe_id_locations = IlluminaMethEpicB5ProbeIDs, 
                                 WGBS_data = WGBS_GRanges,
                                 multipleMapping = TRUE,
                                 cutoff = 10)
deconvolution <- deconvolute(reference = HumanCellTypeMethAtlas, 
                             bulk = mapped_WGBS_data)
deconvolution$proportions

workflows.name: atlas_extension_and_signature_generation
workflows.intent: Extend an existing reference atlas with new sample data or construct tissue-specific CpG/DMP signature matrices.
input: samples (Data frame of new cell type/sample profiles)
sampleMeta (Data table mapping samples to biosample terms)
HumanCellTypeMethAtlas (Existing reference atlas to be extended)
workflows.stages: 1. Prepare new sample data and metadata ;; 2. Extend the reference atlas using findSignatures ;; 3. Construct tissue-specific CpG signature matrices or DMPs by setting tissueSpecCpGs or tissueSpecDMPs to TRUE in findSignatures.
workflows.code:
samples <- simulateCellMix(3,reference = HumanCellTypeMethAtlas)$simulated
sampleMeta <- data.table("Experiment_accession" = colnames(samples)[-1],
                         "Biosample_term_name" = "new cell type")
extended_matrix <- findSignatures(samples = samples, 
                                 sampleMeta = sampleMeta, 
                                 atlas = HumanCellTypeMethAtlas,
                                 IDs = "IDs")

data("HumanCellTypeMethAtlas")
exampleSamples <- simulateCellMix(1,reference = HumanCellTypeMethAtlas)$simulated
exampleMeta <- data.table("Experiment_accession" = "example_sample",
                          "Biosample_term_name" = "example_cell_type")
colnames(exampleSamples) <- c("CpGs", "example_sample")
colnames(HumanCellTypeMethAtlas)[1] <- c("CpGs")

signatures <- findSignatures(
  samples = exampleSamples,
  sampleMeta = exampleMeta,
  atlas = HumanCellTypeMethAtlas,
  IDs = "CpGs", K = 100, tissueSpecCpGs = TRUE)

signatures <- findSignatures(
  samples = exampleSamples,
  sampleMeta = exampleMeta,
  atlas = HumanCellTypeMethAtlas,
  IDs = "CpGs", tissueSpecDMPs = TRUE)
